name: Johnjoe McFadden
notes: Q4: synchronous firing is what makes neurons' fields sum into the conscious cemi field. Q6: field integrates distant information at field speed. Q10: ordinary chips lack an integrating EM field; field-coupled hardware might differ.

name: Susan Pockett
notes: Q3/Q2: denies consciousness causes voluntary action. Q8/Q9: later theory ties consciousness to a specific local spatial field pattern in cortex, not synchrony.

name: Rodolfo Llinas
notes: Q1: consciousness is thalamocortical oscillation, not the field as such. Q7 is his signature (intrinsic activity modulated by senses).

name: Wolf Singer
notes: Q3: free-will sceptic; decisions are fully neural. Q7: stresses intrinsic activity and priors.

name: Tam Hunt
notes: Q8: in general resonance theory all resonating structures have some experience, no special pattern. Q10: depends on shared resonance, not ruled out in principle.

name: Mostyn Jones
notes: Q4: criticises synchrony-binding accounts. Q9: locates experience in local fields of active neurons.
